operating_notes.text: Recommended final dividend of ₹0.15 per fully paid-up equity share of Re. 1 each for the financial year ended March 31, 2026.
FY26 growth was supported by improved demand, execution of a higher order backlog, and capacity utilization of 70-75%.
India's extrusion-line imports were approximately US$507 million in FY25, highlighting an import substitution opportunity.
Rajoo has global installations of over 7,000 machines across 72+ countries.
H1FY27 revenue includes contributions from recently acquired Kohli Printing and Converting Machines Private Limited.
Strategic partnership with Rieckermann entered in September 2026 for Southeast Asia expansion.

timeline.summary: Rajoo Engineers reported Q4FY26 revenue of ₹79.40 crore and PAT of ₹1.83 crore, bringing full-year FY26 revenue to ₹344.25 crore.
Rajoo Engineers announced on May 29, 2026, that shareholders approved the re-appointment of key promoter directors via postal ballot.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹101.91 Cr, net profit to shareholders ₹8.75 Cr.
Rajoo Engineers reported H1FY27 revenue growth of 26.9% YoY to ₹224.98 Cr, though Q2FY27 EBITDA margins contracted sharply to 9.75%.
Rajoo Engineers reported Q2FY27 revenue of ₹101.91 Cr with a sharp EBITDA margin contraction to 9.75% due to cost pressures and project mix.
